test.name: Spec 0069 manual check 4: Reconnect to stacklyd follows the daemon

expected: With stacklyd stopped Reconnect to stacklyd is enabled with no subtitle and the window banner says why; after stacklyd runs again the menu item connects the window, and while connected the item is disabled.
actual: While connected, Stackly > Reconnect to stacklyd was disabled with no subtitle. After stacklyd was killed (window banner `Can’t connect to stacklyd.` and the footer `stacklyd unavailable`) the item was enabled with no subtitle. With stacklyd started again, AXPress on the item connected the window within 4 s and the item read disabled again.
steps: on commit 9d19e4a with a clean tree: `cargo xtask build-app` (Debug), a temporary STACKLY_ROOT under the session scratchpad, `target/debug/stacklyd` with that root, and the app started from target/xcode/Build/Products/Debug/Stackly.app with the same STACKLY_ROOT

Claude Code drove the app with a small AX tool (AXUIElement menu bar dump and AXPress on menu items) and, for keys, `osascript` System Events `keystroke` after bringing the app to the front; CGEvent posts to the pid did not reach the app on this Mac, System Events keystrokes did
`kill <stacklyd pid>`, waited 6 s, read the item state through AX, started stacklyd again with the same STACKLY_ROOT, pressed the item with AXPress, and read it again after 4 s
reviewer: Claude Code (Claude Sonnet 5.5, sub session dev-f69-m2) drove the app; the user has not reviewed this record yet
